Luka Dončić joins HISTORIC company! With tonight’s performance, Luka becomes just the fifth player in NBA history to record at least four games with 30+ points, 10+ assists, 5+ rebounds and 5+ steals since steals became an official statistic in 1973-74. Watch the highlights from another incredible all-around performance!
